control: Smoke uses public Qwen3 0.6B and spec-type none solely to prove same launcher request, result writer and STOP/drain. It does not exercise MTP or establish target throughput, acceptance or identity.
cpu: whole physical host 0-95, GPU quiet exclusive, numactl interleave=all
decision: For each candidate p-min, KEEP only if all 15 matched baseline token sequences are exactly identical, aggregate percentage gain over A0 >= 1.0 + aggregate floor, and each class percentage gain >= -(1.0 + that class floor); otherwise DECLINE if all inputs are complete; unknown evidence yields UNKNOWN. Throughput higher is better. Preserve all attempted requests and failures, no redraw. One timing grant required for the decision; partial/interrupted sequence is incomplete, never combine windows as if one.
floor: within each class and aggregate, max absolute percentage change between the two fresh-server A0 repeats across the five matching blocks in the same actual timing grant; floor is unknown if any required pair is missing or across grants
metric: aggregate decode tokens per second = sum(native predicted_n) / sum(native predicted_ms)*1000; class and all-class use the same formula
